'''Spice wine''' was a variety of [[Wine/Legends|wine]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Vor-cal Feast]], two of [[Annora Calandra]]'s [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] indulged in spice wine, causing them to pass out.<ref name="LE" />
